cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA323. Stand 217, from Wuhan to Singapore, information V. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航323，217号停机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播V，请求飞往新加坡的飞行的许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA323, stand217, information V, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航323, 217号停机位，通播V，目的地新加坡，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 9800m, runway 36R, when airborne, contact departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3652.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度9800米，跑道36右，离地后，联系离场频率119.7，应答机3652。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 9800m, runway 36R, when airborne, contact departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3652. SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度9800米，跑道36右，离地后，联系离场频率119.7，应答机3652，新航323。

cards.audioText: You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA323, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航323，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA323, Wuhan Ground, after A330 behind, pushback and start-up, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，武汉地面，在A330后，推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: After A330 behind, pushback and start-up, facing east, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在A330后，推出开车，面朝东，新航323。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point of runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在跑道36右外等待点，联系塔台，请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323. We are at holding point of runway 36R, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，我们现在在跑道36右外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA323, surface wind light and variable, cleared for takeoff, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，地面轻风，风向多变，可以起飞，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: During takeoff rolling, you find there is a ground vehicle crossing runway 36R. Tell ATC your decision to abort takeoff due runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞滑跑中，你发现一辆地面车辆正在穿越跑道36右，告诉管制员，由于跑道入侵，你决定中断起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, we are aborting takeoff due runway incursion, a ground vehicle is crossing runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，由于跑道入侵，我们中断起飞了，一辆汽车正在穿越跑道。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, roger that, advise intentions when able.
[Now you have vacated runway and checked everything is normal, you want to change runway 36L for departure. Tell Tower. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，收到，可以的时候告知意图。
现在你已经脱离跑道，检查一切正常，你想更换至跑道36左起飞，告知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, everything is normal now, request change runway 36L for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，现在一切正常，请求更换至跑道36左起飞。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, standby for your request. Can you accept intersection departure from Z4?
[Tell tower you can not accept Z4 intersection departure because of your aircraft performance. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，稍等，你可以接受从Z4减跑道起飞吗？
告诉塔台，由于飞机性能，你无法接受从Z4减跑道起飞
cards.referenceText: Negative intersection departure due performance, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于性能，无法减跑道起飞，新航323。

cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，更换至跑道36左起飞。

cards.audioText: You have departed from RWY 36L, shortly after liftoff, your starboard engine was on fire, and the EGT is very high, so you have to shut down this engine, make a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经从跑道36左起飞，起飞不久后，你右侧发动机起火，排气温度非常高，因此你关闭了该发动机，做遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. Wuhan Tower, SIA323, right engine on fire, EGT is too high, we are shutting down the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 武汉塔台，新航323，右侧发动机起火，排气温度过高，我们关闭了该发动机。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, roger MAYDAY. Say your intention.
[Tell the Tower you want to jettison fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，收到MAYDAY，说出你的意图。
告诉塔台，你想放油，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求放油，返回武汉机场，新航323。

cards.audioText: SIA323, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，右转航向240，切LKO VOR 030向台径向线，上3000米保持。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切LKO 030径向向台，上3000米保持，新航323。

cards.audioText: SIA323, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，新航323。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
[Tell Wuhan Approach you need approximately 18 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，告知放油所用时间。
告诉武汉进近，你需要18分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need about 18 minutes for fuel dumping, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约18分钟放油，新航323。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉进近，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA323, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector for runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航323，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在建立ILS进近，跑道22，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，建立ILS进近，跑道22。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, do you need any assistance upon landing?
[inform Tower you need to order emergency evacuation after landing, request a shuttle bus to take passengers to the terminal.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，着陆后需要任何协助吗？
告诉塔台，你需要在着陆后组织紧急撤离，请求一辆摆渡车，将乘客送至航站楼。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need to perform emergency evacuation, request shuttle bus on arrival, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们需要执行紧急撤离，着陆后请求摆渡车。
